text: Walk. You can walk. You can walk like a cat. Stomp. You can stomp. You can stomp like an elephant. Waddle. You can waddle. You can waddle like a duck. Dance. You can dance. You can dance like a ballerina. March. You can march. You can march like a soldier. Skip. You can skip. You can skip like a child. Sing. I can sing! Jump! I can jump! Wow! Look at the children! They can do many things!
